units.source_text: 实在，二女公子这里，能关心万事、照料一切的，除了薰中纳言而外更有何人呢？

en.t: Indeed, who else but Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, could concern himself with every matter and look after everything for the Second Princess?

units.source_text: 匂亲王对二女公子的宠爱原也异乎寻常，其关怀照顾也很周到。

en.t: Prince Niou's affection for the Second Princess was, to be sure, extraordinary, and his concern and care were also very attentive.

units.source_text: 然而生活上琐屑之事，他哪能注意到呢？

en.t: Yet how could he ever notice the petty details of daily life?

units.source_text: 这位皇子生长深宫，养尊处优，不知世间疾苦为何物，原是当然之事。

en.t: This prince had grown up deep within the palace, pampered and privileged, so it was only natural that he knew nothing of the hardships of the world.

units.source_text: 他经常度着风流艳雅的生活，玩弄花露还怕指冷呢。

en.t: He always lived a refined and elegant life, and even playing with dew on flowers made him fear that his fingers would grow cold.

units.source_text: 同他比较起来，像薰中纳言那样为了所爱之人而随时用心，一草一木也照顾到，实在是难能可贵。

en.t: Compared with him, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was truly rare and admirable in constantly taking thought for the person he loved, caring even for every blade of grass and tree.

units.source_text: 因此二女公子的乳母等人往往讥讽匂亲王：“他的照顾算了吧！”

en.t: For that reason, the Second Princess's nurses and attendants often mocked Prince Niou, saying, "So much for his care!"

units.source_text: 女童中有几个人衣衫不整，二女公子看了颇觉羞耻，有时不免私下叹苦：“住在这华厦里反而出丑了。”

en.t: Several of the young servant girls were poorly dressed, and when the Second Princess saw them she felt deeply ashamed, sometimes lamenting in private, "Living in this splendid mansion only makes us look disgraceful."

units.source_text: 何况此时六条院左大臣家排场之奢华天下闻名，匂亲王的随从人等看到这里的状况，安得不见笑呢？

en.t: Moreover, at this time the magnificence of the Left Minister's household at Rokujo-in was renowned throughout the world, so how could Prince Niou's attendants see conditions here without laughing?

units.source_text: 因此二女公子更加不快，常常悲叹。

en.t: Because of this, the Second Princess became still more distressed and often grieved.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言很会推察她的心事，所以送这些衣物来。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was very good at discerning what was in her heart, and so he sent these garments.

units.source_text: 倘对交情疏阔之人，送这些琐屑之物太不成样，有失礼貌。

en.t: If one sent such trifling things to someone with whom one had only a distant acquaintance, it would look quite improper and discourteous.

units.source_text: 但送二女公子，并无轻侮之嫌，有何不可呢？

en.t: But when sending them to the Second Princess, there was no hint of contempt, so what could be wrong with it?

units.source_text: 如果送她隆重的礼物，反而引起旁人讥议，被认为过分讨好。

en.t: If he sent her a grand gift, it would instead invite criticism from others and be seen as excessive flattery.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言顾虑及此，所以只送些现成品。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, took this into account, and therefore sent only some ready-made items.

units.source_text: 另外他又命人缝制种种美丽的衣服，又织造一些礼服，连同许多绫罗衣料一并送去。

en.t: In addition, he ordered people to sew all sorts of beautiful garments and to weave some formal robes, sending them together with many fine silk fabrics.

units.source_text: 原来这位中纳言也是从小在锦绣丛中长大起来的，其养尊处优并不亚于匂亲王。

en.t: After all, this Middle Counselor too had grown up from childhood surrounded by luxury, and in pampered privilege he was no less favored than Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 心性异常骄矜，处世目空一切，真是个佼佼不群的超人。

en.t: His nature was exceptionally proud, and in dealing with the world he looked down on everything, truly an extraordinary man who stood apart from the crowd.

units.source_text: 然而自从看到了已故八亲王宇治山庄的光景以来，始知失势之人，原来生涯如此悬殊，实甚可怜。

en.t: Yet ever since he had seen the state of the late Eighth Prince's villa at Uji, he had come to understand how vastly different the lives of those who had lost their position could be, and how truly pitiable they were.

units.source_text: 于是推想广大世间种种情况，常常寄予深切的同情。

en.t: He then imagined the many different circumstances in the wide world and often felt deep sympathy for them.

units.source_text: 可知这是一番沉痛的经验。

en.t: From this one can see that it was a deeply painful experience.
